title: Make MSBuild diagnostic enablement forgiving or explicitly observable
outcome: Make MSBuild diagnostic enablement forgiving or explicitly observable
acceptance: Choose and document an operator-facing enablement contract: accept trimmed ordinary truthy spellings case-insensitively, or emit a single safe diagnostic for an unrecognized nonempty setting.
Product tests pin enabled, disabled and unrecognized values, without logging raw MSBuild data into ordinary telemetry or changing evaluator behavior.
